title: refactor(i18n, plugin-designer)!: retire the unread designer.versionHistory key
body:
domain:ui#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jQjvWkZ7is6GXbC6DB

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNE8dPMmLJuNbseKNWAA5ER)_

Part of #25921. This batch retires the `designer.versionHistory` i18n key that #29529 (`389de4aa`) left with no reader when it deleted the `VersionHistory` module from `@object-ui/plugin-designer`. It runs under claim 6587895888. The umbrella stays open; nothing else it lists is touched.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：从十个语言包（ar、de、en、es、fr、ja、ko、pt、ru、zh）和设计器导出的英文兜底表 `DESIGNER_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` 里删除 `designer.versionHistory` 这一条文案，共 11 行。
- 为什么改：#29529 已删除设计器的“版本历史”面板，这条文案从此没有任何界面读取，留着只会让翻译人员继续维护它，也让死键检查一直报它。
- 风险与回滚：界面不变，因为没有页面显示这条文案。对外只影响 TypeScript：导出的 `TranslationKeys` 类型少了这个键，外部若引用会编译报错；导出的兜底表读这一行会得到 undefined。changeset 为两个包写明了删掉引用即可。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`（类型来源）、`ui/packages/plugin-designer/src/hooks/useDesignerTranslation.ts`、`.changeset/25921-designer-version-history-key.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "designer.versionHistory" -- ui ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'`，预期无输出（退出码 1）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（入队前欠一次契约复审档复审，由席位转总监）。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt,ru,zh}.ts`: the `versionHistory` entry under `designer` is deleted (one line each). `designer.undo`, `designer.redo` and `designer.canvasMinimap` stay.
- `ui/packages/plugin-designer/src/hooks/useDesignerTranslation.ts`: the `'designer.versionHistory'` row leaves `DESIGNER_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`. The map is exported from the package entry (`src/index.tsx`) and app-shell's mirror gate imports it, so a read of that row now yields `undefined`; the map's type is unchanged.
- `.changeset/25921-designer-version-history-key.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/plugin-designer` patch, BREAKING (TypeScript only for i18n; the plugin-designer sentence names the exported map's lost row and #29529 as the predecessor), with the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-interface-only ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts#TranslationKeys)` beside a `| Removed key | Replacement |` table whose replacement is "none".

## Tests

No test file changes. Neither i18n pin moves: `dead-key-batch-retired-4730.test.ts` does not list the key in its SURVIVING list, and the de value "Versionsverlauf" carries no quote pair, so the `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` census is unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **No reader remains.** On `origin/main` `50e35a28`, `git grep -n versionHistory -- ui ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` found the 11 definitions above plus `ui/packages/types/src/designer.ts:1416` (`CollaborationConfig.versionHistory?: boolean`, a different symbol, not an i18n key). There is no `t('designer.versionHistory')`, no `designer.` template composition that could produce it (the only `designer.` template is `designer.object.reqPerms.op.OP` in `ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx`), and no test pin. After this PR the same grep returns only the `types` line.
- **`CollaborationConfig.versionHistory`** (`ui/packages/types/src/designer.ts:1416`) has no reader either. It is a dead declared field, out of scope here and not filed (zero-pull, carrier: none).
- **Seat 3's pending changeset** `.changeset/25921-plugin-designer-dead-collaboration-version-history.md` (from #29529, not yet released) says the key "stays in the locale packs for now, with no reader". Once this lands, that sentence is outdated. It is outside this PR's declared file surface, so it is left as is for the seat to decide.
